articles.title: ‘Body kept in car for 7 hours’: How a Gurgaon meeting ended in HR professional’s murder
articles.description: A 31-year-old HR professional was allegedly murdered after meeting a former colleague. Police arrested the former colleague, Anya Vats, and her partner, Sanyam Sachdeva. Investigators suspect a financial dispute led to the alleged killing of Yuvraj Singh Manchanda. The couple reportedly confessed to dumping the body in a sewer near their home. They were apprehended in Uttarakhand after fleeing the scene.

articles.description: Homestead Metro Park in Hilliard, Ohio, is set to bloom with an expansive addition of 333 conservation acres, elevating its size to nearly nine times larger than before. This remarkable land transfer is a collaboration between the city and M/I Homes, paving the way for enhanced trails and natural habitats. Visitors can look forward to exploring this enlarged haven after several years of dedicated development.

articles.title: Owens Questions School Event: Candace Owens alleges TPUSA forced assembly; online fight over youth outreach
articles.description: Candace Owens questioned a TPUSA Club America event at Nampa Christian School after images showed more than 500 high school students gathered in the gym. Owens claimed students were required to attend and that parents were not allowed to join them. A separate post celebrated the turnout and Erika Kirk’s appearance. The claims sparked online debate over political outreach in schools and student participation, with details about attendance policies remaining disputed.

articles.title: Five Indiana engineering students built a 12-hour wearable that helps visually impaired users detect obstacles beyond a cane or guide dog
articles.description: Rose-Hulman students have developed a remarkable wearable device tailored for visually impaired individuals. This innovative headgear employs advanced sensors to identify surrounding obstacles, providing users with haptic feedback. With a remarkable twelve-hour battery life on a single charge, this device empowers users with greater independence. The project's goal is to enhance the day-to-day experiences of those with vision impairments.

articles.title: Miley Cyrus talks about what she learned from Dolly Parton
articles.description: Miley Cyrus reflected on the wisdom imparted by her godmother, Dolly Parton, following her passing. She shared that their contrasting musical styles only deepened their relationship. Parton encouraged Cyrus to create a clear separation between her on-stage persona and her personal life. While they occasionally disagreed on how emotions should be expressed in performances, Cyrus now treasures the lessons from her influential mentors, including the iconic Parton.

articles.title: MS Subbulakshmi's remarkable journey
articles.description: M.S. Subbulakshmi's life and musical journey are being adapted into a new film. Rashmika Mandanna will portray the iconic Carnatic vocalist in the upcoming biopic. The film's announcement coincided with M.S. Subbulakshmi's 110th birth anniversary. Director Gowtam Tinnanuri is helming the project, with music by Anirudh Ravichander. Actor Kamal Haasan offered encouragement to Mandanna at the film's launch event.

articles.title: Ramanand Sagar's grandson: 'Ranbir is more Krishna than Rama'
articles.description: Shiv Sagar, grandson of Ramanand Sagar, shared his views on Ranbir Kapoor's casting. He felt Kapoor was more suited for Lord Krishna's playful character. Sagar noted his family's long-standing connection with the Kapoor family. Arun Govil's casting as King Dasharath was also discussed by Sagar. Nitesh Tiwari's Ramayana is set for a Diwali release.
